### Checklist

- [ ] The entry is added to `plugins` without changing other entries.
- [ ] `id` and `version` match the package manifest; the package contains `LICENSE.txt`.
- [ ] All URLs are public HTTPS addresses I control or may link to.
- [ ] The plugin is my own work or I have the right to publish it, and it is not a copy of a plugin from the creator
      distributed against its license (`docs/release/LICENSING-PROPOSAL.md`).
- [ ] I understand that passing the automatic checks does not mean the plugin is safe or accepted.
